statement: Provide an instant wind analysis from a learned model that returns speed ratios and pedestrian comfort for the current proposal and chosen wind directions.
superiority: Validated against public wind-tunnel data with reported hit rates, and shows its error bars.

acceptance.corpus: AIJ (Architectural Institute of Japan) wind-tunnel benchmark case: single high-rise block, public pedestrian-wind data used in CFD validation (Tominaga et al. 2008)
COST Action 732 Michelstadt and CEDVAL street canyon data (public)

notes: Autodesk describes rapid wind as AI-model based and more directional; Dino 8 may satisfy the row with a physics solver if it meets the accuracy and latency budget. key=wind_rapid

statement: Run a full simulation wind analysis for the proposal with more time and fidelity, suitable for documentation, returning speed ratios and comfort classes.
superiority: Open settings, mesh and turbulence model visible; accuracy reported per public benchmark.

empty domain, neutral log-law inflow: profile preserved downstream (closed form u*/k ln(z/z0))

notes: CFD settings of the real product (mesh, turbulence model) are not public; the row is defined by outputs and accuracy. key=wind_detailed

single reflecting wall, image-source closed form

single box shading a point; blocked direct fraction by projection
